chapter.verse: Pasian aw, nangma luahna gam sungah dawi biate hong pai uh hi; amaute in nangma biakinn siangtho nin sak uh hi; amaute in Jerusalem siasak khin uh hi.
Amaute in, nangma nasemte’ pumpite, a an dingun huih lak vasate pia uh a, na misiangthote’ sate, lei lak ganhingte pia uh hi.
Amaute in, Jerusalem kimkot-ah tui bangin amaute’ sisan buakhia uh a, amaute a vui ding kuamah om lo hi.
Kote in ka vengte uh’ zahko, ka kim uh-a omte’ ko leh nuihsat ka suak khin uh hi.
Topa aw, bang tanvei hi ding hiam? Heh paisuak ding na hi hiam? Nangma hazat hehna, mei bangin kuang paisuak ding ahi hiam?
Nangmah hong thei lo minamte tung leh, nangma tunga thu hong ngen lo kumpi gamte tungah heh gawp in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ka mite uh thatmang khin a, ka gam sung uh susia gawp hi.
Ka pu ka pate uh mawhna hangin kote hong lang ngaihsut kei in la, kote hong kiniam koih mahmah ahih manin, kote hong dawntuah dingin na hehpihna hong paisak mengmeng in.
Kote’ kihotkhiatna Pasian aw, nangma min a than’ nadingin kote hong huh in la, nangma min hangin kote hong khahkhia-in ka mawhna uh hong maisak in!
“Amau’ Pasian koi-ah om hiam?” minamte in a cih ding bang hangin kilawm ding ahi hiam? Na nasemte’ sisan luangkhia phulakna pen, minamte’ lak, komau’ muhna-ah kitheisak in!
Thongkiate’ taunate ngai in la, thah dinga a kisehte nangma vangliatna tawh kizui-in suakta sak in!
Amaute in nang hong zahkona mah tawh ka vengte uh’ ang sungah a zah sagih-in thuk in, Topa!
Tua ciangin, nangma mi, nangma gamsung tuu ahi kote in, na tungah lungdamna kong lak ngitnget ding uh a, a khang a khangin nangmah phatnate ka gengen ding uh hi.
